articles.title: Reddit Experiments with Search Ads As Business Growth Faces Pressure
articles.description: Reddit is trying a new approach to advertising by testing sponsored promotions directly within its search results. The experiment comes as the platform faces challenges from declining search referrals and slower audience growth. The initial trial, announced on November 3, involves a limited number of advertisers. It will allow businesses to display relevant promotions when users search for products, recommendations and other topics across the platform. The new format could create another source of advertising income for Reddit. It also gives brands an opportunity to connect with users who are actively looking for specific products or services. Search Ads to Match User Interests Reddit's advertising system will consider the relevance of promotions to individual search queries. This means users could see advertisements connected to the topics they are exploring. “Ads in search may appear based on a range of factors, including contextual relevance to a user’s search query,” Reddit said. For example, users searching for coffee-making products may see advertisements for coffee machines and other related items. People looking for home office ideas could also find ads for desks, monitors and other office products. Reddit plans to review how the trial performs and gather feedback from users. The company will use these findings to decide whether any changes are needed before expanding the feature. The test comes as Google's AI-powered search tools are changing the way people find information online. Users can now get answers directly on Google's search page without visiting other websites. This shift is reducing traffic for platforms such as Reddit that depend on visitors coming through search engines. Focus on Advertising Reddit's third-quarter financial performance showed revenue and earnings above market expectations. However, its shares declined after the company issued a fourth-quarter revenue forecast below analysts' estimates. The company expects fourth-quarter revenue of USD 1 billion to USD 1.03 billion. Analysts had projected USD 1.05 billion. Reddit reported 130.3 million daily active users worldwide during the third quarter. The number was unchanged from the previous quarter. Its US daily active user base declined to 50.7 million from 53.2 million. The company is also gradually moving towards a logged-in user experience, beginning with markets outside the US. This approach could limit unauthorised AI content collection and give advertisers a clearer understanding of audience interests.

articles.title: Jollibee Unveils Upgraded Jolliburger Beef Burger Collection in Hong Kong
articles.description: Crafted fresh-to-order with 100% Aussie beef, debuting the limited-edition Jolliburger Truffle alongside the fully elevated Jolliburger Aloha HONG KONG SAR - Media OutReach Newswire - 4 November 2026 - Jollibee, the beloved global restaurant brand in Hong Kong, is committed to serving great-tasting food and bringing simple joy to every customer. Starting today, Jollibee rolls out its newly upgraded Jolliburger Collection in Hong Kong, presenting a lineup of three distinct, mouthwatering beef burgers: the newly introduced limited-time Jolliburger Truffle, the enhanced Jolliburger Aloha with elevated taste and texture, and the flagship Jolliburger Deluxe, a fan favourite since its August 2025 launch. Made with 100% premium Aussie beef and cooked fresh-to-order, every burger is crafted with care to lock in natural juiciness and flavour, delivering exceptional value and "bee-licious" happiness to every burger lover! 100% Premium Aussie Beef x Fresh-to-Order Jollibee understands that fast food is more than just a quick and convenient meal; it also aims to offer customers a well-deserved reward amid their busy daily routines. The newly upgraded Jolliburger Collection anchors on two key highlights: freshly made and quality ingredients. Featuring 100% premium Aussie beef as its soul, paired with crisp fresh vegetables and cheddar cheese, every burger is strictly cooked fresh-to-order. Expertly grilled to seal in rich savoury juices and deep beef aroma, Jollibee invites customers to savour a high-quality, bee-licious dining experience at exceptional value, anytime and anywhere. A Trio of Delights: Debut of Limited-EditionFlavour The upgraded Jolliburger Collection debuts with three distinct signature beef burgers, each offering unique characteristics to satisfy diverse palates. The limited-time Jolliburger Truffle specialty features 100% premium Aussie beef patties blended with rich, aromatic black truffle sauce, paired with grilled mushrooms and fresh, crisp rocket lettuce for an irresistible, layered gourmet flavour. The beloved Jolliburger Aloha is also fully elevated, combining a juicy Aussie beef patty with a sweet pineapple ring, crispy bacon, and special garlic mayo, delivering a harmonious sweet-and-savoury balance with tropical flavours in every bite. Launched last summer as the brand's flagship, Jolliburger Deluxe features double 100% Aussie beef patties layered with melted double cheddar cheese, crisp lettuce, and fresh tomatoes, bringing out a rich "Double Beefy, Double Cheesy" satisfaction that continues to win praise as the ultimate classic beef burger. Available Today Across Designated Stores in Hong Kong The upgraded Jolliburger Collection is now available at Jollibee stores across Hong Kong (except the Euro Trade Centre store in Central; the Hong Kong International Airport store serves only Jolliburger Deluxe and Jolliburger Aloha). The Jolliburger Deluxe and Jolliburger Aloha are priced at HK$40 à la carte and HK$53 for the value meal. The limited-time offer, Jolliburger Truffle, is priced at HK$42 à la carte and HK$55 for the value meal. Burger enthusiasts are invited to visit stores today to experience double the joyful surprise of 100% Aussie beef and cooked fresh-to-order! Hashtag: #Jollibee #JollibeeHK #Jolliburger #100AussieBeef #TasteOfJoy The issuer is solely responsible for the content of this announcement. About Jollibee Hong KongJollibee, an international fast-food brand with over 1,600 branches globally, is dedicated to the brand philosophy of "serving great-tasting food and bringing the joy of eating to everyone", especially through its widely loved signature product, Chickenjoy. The first Jollibee branch in Hong Kong opened in Central in 1996, and since then, the brand has expanded into a total of 26 branches in Hong Kong. articles.title: Mitchell Starc reclaims No.1 spot in ICC Test rankings after nine-wicket haul against South Africa
articles.description: Australian pacer Mitchell Starc has returned to the No.1 spot in the ICC Men's Test Bowling Rankings with a stellar performance in the third and final game of the World Test Championship against South Africa in Cape Town. The left-arm speedster moved up by a spot with his 9-wicket haul in the match to overtake South Africa's Marco Jansen.
